question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Scary."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Comforting.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Scary" means causing fear; frightening. (डरावना)

 

• "Comforting" means providing consolation, reassurance, or physical ease. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सांत्वनादायक)

◦ Example: Her comforting words helped calm the frightened children during the long and stormy night.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Frightening (भयावह) — causing fear or terror; a synonym of scary.

• Option 3: Eerie (रहस्यमयी) — strange and frightening in a mysterious way; a synonym of scary.

• Option 4: Terrifying (भयंकर) — causing extreme fear; a synonym of scary.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of scary: Reassuring, Soothing, Calming.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Intimate (घनिष्ठ): Distant (दूर), Unfamiliar (अपरिचित)

2. Intransigence (हठ / कट्टरता): Compromise (समझौता), Flexibility (लचीलापन)

3. Intrinsic (आंतरिक): Extrinsic (बाहरी)

4. Irresolute (अस्थिर): Decisive (निर्णायक)

5. Jeopardise (खतरे में डालना): Safeguard (सुरक्षित रखना), Protect (रक्षा करना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Give back".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Keep.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Give back" means to return something to its original owner. (वापस करना)

◦ Example: He promised to give back the borrowed umbrella as soon as the rain stopped.

 

• "Keep" means to retain possession of something and not return it, and is therefore the correct antonym. (रखना)

◦ Example: The tenant decided to keep the security deposit instead of returning it to the landlord.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Refund (धनवापसी करना): to pay back money that was received — a synonym of give back, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Restore (पुनः स्थापित करना): to bring back to an original state or owner — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Return (वापस करना): to give something back to its owner — close in sense to give back.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of give back: Return, Restore, Refund, Repay.

• Synonyms of keep: Retain, Hold, Possess, Preserve.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Jeopardy (खतरा): Safety (सुरक्षा)

2. Jettison (फेंक देना): Accept (स्वीकार करना), Retain (रखना)

3. Jibes (ताने): Contradict (विरोध करना)

4. Jovial (खुशमिजाज): Morose (उदास), Gloomy (निराश)

5. Joyous (खुशहाल): Melancholic (उदास), Sad (दुखी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Jeopardy."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Safety.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Jeopardy" means danger of loss, harm, or failure. (खतरा)

 

• "Safety" means the condition of being protected from danger or harm. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सुरक्षा)

◦ Example: Strict building codes were enforced to ensure the safety of residents living in earthquake-prone areas.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Danger (खतरा) — the possibility of suffering harm; a synonym of jeopardy.

• Option 3: Risk (जोखिम) — exposure to the possibility of loss; a synonym of jeopardy.

• Option 4: Peril (संकट) — serious and immediate danger; a synonym of jeopardy.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of jeopardy: Security, Protection, Shelter.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Judicious (विवेकपूर्ण): Irrational (अतार्किक), Foolish (मूर्खतापूर्ण)

2. Knave (धोखेबाज़): Paragon (आदर्श व्यक्ति), Honest (ईमानदार)

3. Laborious (कठिन/मेहनती): Facile (सरल)

4. Lachrymose (आँसू भरा): Jovial (प्रसन्न), Cheerful (खुशमिजाज)

5. Lament (शोक करना): Celebrate (उत्सव मनाना), Rejoice (खुश होना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Redeem."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Forfeit.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Redeem" means to compensate for a fault; to make amends. (सुधारना)

 

• "Forfeit" means to lose or give up as a penalty. It is therefore the correct antonym. (गंवाना)

◦ Example: Players who arrive late will forfeit their place in the tournament without any exception.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Retrieve (पुनः प्राप्त करना) — to get or bring something back; a synonym of redeem.

• Option 2: Recover (फिर से पाना) — to regain possession or use of something; a synonym of redeem.

• Option 3: Reclaim (वापस पाना) — to obtain the return of something; a synonym of redeem.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of redeem: Ruin, Lose, Surrender.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Languid (सुस्त): Vigorous (ऊर्जावान), Energetic (सक्रिय)

2. Large (बड़ा): Tiny (छोटा), Small (छोटा)

3. Lassitude (थकावट): Vigor (ऊर्जा), Energy (स्फूर्ति)

4. Transient (क्षणिक): Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (दीर्घकालिक)

5. Late (देरी से): Early (जल्दी)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Anile".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Young.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Anile" means resembling a feeble old woman; showing weakness typical of old age. (बुढ़ापे जैसा)

◦ Example: Critics dismissed the outdated policy as an anile approach unsuited to modern economic realities.

 

• "Young" means having lived or existed for only a short time; not old, and is therefore the correct antonym. (युवा)

◦ Example: The young entrepreneur launched her first startup shortly after graduating from college.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Doddering (लड़खड़ाता हुआ): shaky or feeble because of old age — a synonym of anile, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Senile (जराजीर्ण): showing mental weakness due to old age — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Decrepit (जर्जर): weakened by old age or long use — close in sense to anile.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of anile: Senile, Doddering, Decrepit, Feeble, Infirm.

• Synonyms of young: Youthful, Juvenile, Adolescent, Fresh, Vigorous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Laudable (प्रशंसनीय): Deplorable (निंदनीय), Shameful (शर्मनाक)

2. Lax (लापरवाह): Strict (सख्त), Careful (सावधान)

3. Left (बाएं/छोड़ा गया): Right (दायां)

4. Leisure (फुर्सत): Working (कार्यरत)

5. Lengthy (लंबा / विस्तृत): Concise (संक्षिप्त), Brief (संक्षेप)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Precise."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Rough.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Precise" means exact and accurate; clearly stated or defined. (सटीक)

 

• "Rough" means not exact or accurate; approximate or crudely done. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अस्पष्ट/अनगढ़)

◦ Example: He gave a rough estimate of the project's cost since the final figures weren't ready yet.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Exact (ठीक-ठीक) — correct in every detail; precise; a synonym of precise.

• Option 2: Accurate (यथार्थ) — correct and free from error; a synonym of precise.

• Option 3: Meticulous (सूक्ष्म) — showing great attention to detail; a synonym of precise.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of precise: Approximate, Imprecise, Vague.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Less (कम): More (अधिक), Plenty (प्रचुर)

2. Lethargic (सुस्त): Active (सक्रिय)

3. Levity (हल्कापन): Gravity (गंभीरता), Seriousness (गंभीरता)

4. Liberation (मुक्ति): Captivity (कैद), Bondage (बंधन)

5. Lonely (अकेला): Crowded (भीड़भाड़), Social (सामाजिक)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Overt".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Hidden.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Overt" means done or shown openly; not secret or hidden. (प्रत्यक्ष)

◦ Example: The company's overt support for the campaign was evident in its public advertisements and donations.

 

• "Hidden" means kept out of sight; not visible or apparent, and is therefore the correct antonym. (छिपा हुआ)

◦ Example: A hidden camera in the lobby captured footage of the break-in last night.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Open (खुला): not concealed or secret — a synonym of overt, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Obvious (स्पष्ट): easily perceived or understood — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Evident (प्रकट): clearly visible or apparent — close in sense to overt.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of overt: open, obvious, evident, apparent, manifest.

• Synonyms of hidden: concealed, secret, covert, disguised, unseen.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Lost (खोया हुआ): Found (मिला हुआ), Located (खोजा गया)

2. Loyal (वफादार): Fickle (अस्थिर/बेवफा)

3. Lucid (स्पष्ट): Vague (अस्पष्ट), Confusing (भ्रमित करने वाला)

4. Lugubrious (उदास): Joyous (आनंदित), Cheerful (प्रसन्न)

5. Magnanimous (उदार): Petty (तुच्छ), Selfish (स्वार्थी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Thwart."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Assist.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Thwart" means prevent someone from accomplishing something; obstruct. (विफल करना)

 

• "Assist" means help someone by sharing the work or providing support. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सहायता करना)

◦ Example: Local volunteers were quick to assist the flood victims by distributing food, water, and warm blankets.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Foil (विफल करना) — prevent a plan or attempt from succeeding; a synonym of thwart.

• Option 2: Obstruct (रोकना) — block or get in the way of; a synonym of thwart.

• Option 4: Hinder (बाधा डालना) — create difficulty for someone, delaying progress; a synonym of thwart.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of thwart: Help, Facilitate, Support.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Maladroit (अकुशल / भद्दा): Skillful (कुशल), Expert (निपुण)

2. Malevolent (दुष्ट): Kind (दयालु), Benevolent (उदार)

3. Malice (द्वेष): Kindness (दयालुता), Goodwill (सद्भावना)

4. Malleable (लचीला): Stiff (कठोर), Hard (सख्त)

5. Material (भौतिक): Abstract (अमूर्त), Spiritual (आध्यात्मिक)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Get on."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Remain.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Get on" means to climb aboard a vehicle such as a bus or train. (चढ़ना)

 

• "Remain" means to stay in the same place without leaving or moving on. It is therefore the correct antonym. (रुकना)

◦ Example: The soldiers were ordered to remain at their posts until further instructions arrived that evening.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Board (सवार होना) — to get on a ship, train, or aircraft; a synonym of get on.

• Option 3: Embark (चढ़ना) — to go on board a vehicle or ship; a synonym of get on.

• Option 4: Mount (चढ़ना) — to climb up onto something; a synonym of get on.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of get on: Stay, Linger, Continue.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Mature (परिपक्व): Immature (अपरिपक्व), Childish (बचपना)

2. Mean (मतलबी): Sympathetic (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण), Kind (दयालु)

3. Meander (टेढ़ा-मेढ़ा चलना): Direct (सीधा), Straight (सीधा)

4. Mechanical (यांत्रिक): Manual (हस्तचालित), Natural (प्राकृतिक)

5. Memory (स्मृति): Oblivion (विस्मृति), Forgetfulness (भूलना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Hegemony".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Subordination.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Hegemony" means leadership or dominance of one group or state over others. (आधिपत्य)

◦ Example: The empire's hegemony over the region lasted for nearly two centuries before its decline.

 

• "Subordination" means the state of being under the control or authority of another, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अधीनता)

◦ Example: The smaller kingdom's subordination to its powerful neighbour lasted until it finally regained independence.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Dominance (प्रभुत्व): power and influence over others — a synonym of hegemony, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Supremacy (सर्वोच्चता): the state of being superior in power or authority — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Domination (वर्चस्व): control or power over others — close in sense to hegemony.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of hegemony: Dominance, Supremacy, Domination, Control, Ascendancy.

• Synonyms of subordination: Subjugation, Servitude, Dependence, Submission.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Mesmerize (आकर्षित करना): Repel (दूर करना), Deter (हतोत्साहित करना)

2. Messy (गंदा): Organised (साफ-सुथरा), Tidy (व्यवस्थित)

3. Meticulous (सावधान): Negligent (लापरवाह), Careless (असावधान)

4. Minute (सूक्ष्म): Enormous (विशाल), Huge (बहुत बड़ा)

5. Misanthropic (मानवद्वेषी): Sociable (मिलनसार), Friendly (मित्रवत)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Adage".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Misconstruction.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Adage" means a short traditional saying that expresses a widely accepted truth. (कहावत)

◦ Example: As the adage goes, actions speak louder than words when judging someone's true character.

 

• "Misconstruction" means a wrong or mistaken interpretation of something said or written, and is therefore the correct antonym. (गलत अर्थ)

◦ Example: His careless misconstruction of the contract's terms led to a costly and prolonged legal dispute.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Maxim (सूक्ति): a short statement expressing a general truth — a synonym of adage, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Aphorism (सूत्र वाक्य): a concise statement of a general principle — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Proverb (कहावत): a short well-known saying expressing wisdom — close in sense to adage.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of adage: Proverb, Maxim, Aphorism, Saying, Axiom.

• Synonyms of misconstruction: Misinterpretation, Misunderstanding, Misreading, Distortion, Confusion.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Miserable (दुखी): Cheerful (खुश), Happy (प्रसन्न)

2. Mobile (चलायमान): Standing (स्थिर)

3. Modest (विनम्र): Conceited (घमंडी), Proud (अहंकारी)

4. Monotonous (नीरस): Engrossing (रोचक), Interesting (दिलचस्प)

5. Monstrous (भयानक / विशाल): Beautiful (सुंदर), Gentle (कोमल)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Flexible."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Rigid.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Flexible" means able to bend easily without breaking; adaptable to change. (लचीला)

 

• "Rigid" means unable to bend or be changed; strict and inflexible. It is therefore the correct antonym. (कठोर)

◦ Example: The old bureaucratic system was too rigid to accommodate the sudden changes required during the crisis.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Elastic (लोचदार) — capable of stretching and returning to shape; a synonym of flexible.

• Option 2: Adaptable (अनुकूलनीय) — able to adjust to new conditions; a synonym of flexible.

• Option 4: Pliable (लचीला) — easily bent or shaped; a synonym of flexible.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of flexible: Stiff, Inflexible, Unyielding.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Morbid (उदासपूर्ण): Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Lively (जीवंत)

2. Munificent (उदार): Stingy (कंजूस), Miserly (कृपण)

3. Mythical (काल्पनिक): Verifiable (सत्यापित), Real (वास्तविक)

4. Naïve (भोला): Cynical (संशयी), Experienced (अनुभवी)

5. Nascent (प्रारंभिक): Withering (मुरझाया हुआ), Mature (परिपक्व)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Credulous".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Skeptical.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Credulous" means too ready to believe things; easily deceived or convinced. (भोला)

◦ Example: The credulous investor believed the fraudster's promises without ever questioning the suspiciously high guaranteed returns.

 

• "Skeptical" means having doubts about the truth or value of something, and is therefore the correct antonym. (संदेहवादी)

◦ Example: Scientists remained skeptical about the miracle cure until rigorous clinical trials could confirm its actual effectiveness.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Gullible (भोला): easily persuaded to believe something — a synonym of credulous, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Naive (भोला-भाला): showing lack of experience or judgment — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Trusting (विश्वासी): inclined to trust others readily — close in sense to credulous.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of credulous: gullible, naive, trusting, unsuspecting.

• Synonyms of skeptical: doubtful, cynical, distrustful, questioning.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Native (मूल निवासी): Alien (विदेशी), Foreign (विदेशी)

2. Nefarious (दुष्ट): Pious (पवित्र), Virtuous (सदाचारी)

3. Nervous (घबराया): Courageous (साहसी), Calm (शांत)

4. Niggardly (कंजूस): Lavish (उदारतापूर्वक खर्च करने वाला), Generous (उदार)

5. Noisome (हानिकारक / दुर्गंधयुक्त): Fragrant (सुगंधित), Harmless (हानिरहित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Debacle."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Success.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Debacle" means a sudden humiliating failure or collapse. (पराजय)

 

• "Success" means the accomplishment of an aim or purpose; a favorable outcome. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सफलता)

◦ Example: The product launch was a resounding success, exceeding sales expectations within the very first week.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Disaster (आपदा) — a sudden event causing great damage; a synonym of debacle.

• Option 2: Failure (विफलता) — lack of success in something; a synonym of debacle.

• Option 4: Fiasco (बड़ी असफलता) — a complete and humiliating failure; a synonym of debacle.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of debacle: Triumph, Victory, Achievement.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Nominal (नाममात्र): Significant (महत्वपूर्ण)

2. Nonchalant (उदासीन): Considerate (विचारशील)

3. Notion (धारणा): Reality (वास्तविकता), Fact (सत्य)

4. Noxious (विषैला): Beneficial (लाभकारी), Safe (सुरक्षित)

5. Nugatory (महत्वहीन): Significant (महत्वपूर्ण), Important (जरूरी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Squirm."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Relax.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Squirm" means to wriggle or twist about due to discomfort or unease. (घबराना/बेचैन होना)

 

• "Relax" means to become or make less tense or anxious. It is therefore the correct antonym. (आराम करना)

◦ Example: After the long exam, the students finally relaxed and chatted freely in the courtyard.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Wriggle (छटपटाना) — to twist and turn restlessly; a synonym of squirm.

• Option 2: Writhe (तड़पना) — to twist the body in pain; a synonym of squirm.

• Option 3: Fidget (बेचैनी से हिलना) — to move restlessly out of nervousness; a synonym of squirm.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of squirm: Calm, Unwind, Rest.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Obdurate (जिद्दी): Yielding (झुकने वाला), Flexible (लचीला)

2. Obfuscate (अस्पष्ट करना): Clarify (स्पष्ट करना)

3. Object (आपत्ति करना): Assent (सहमति देना), Agree (सहमत होना)

4. Obliged (आभारी): Thankless (कृतघ्न), Ungrateful (अकृतज्ञ)

5. Obloquy (अपमान / बदनामी): Praise (प्रशंसा), Respect (सम्मान)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Durable."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Fragile.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Durable" means able to withstand wear and last a long time. (टिकाऊ)

 

• "Fragile" means easily broken or damaged; delicate. It is therefore the correct antonym. (नाजुक)

◦ Example: The antique vase was so fragile that it had to be wrapped carefully before shipping.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Sturdy (मजबूत) — strongly built and unlikely to break; a synonym of durable.

• Option 3: Robust (सुदृढ़) — strong and unlikely to fail; a synonym of durable.

• Option 4: Resilient (सहनशील) — able to withstand stress and recover; a synonym of durable.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of durable: Weak, Delicate, Flimsy.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Obscure (अस्पष्ट): Prominent (प्रमुख), Clear (स्पष्ट)

2. Obsequious (चापलूस): Assertive (आत्मविश्वासी), Independent (स्वतंत्र)

3. Obsolete (अप्रचलित / पुराना): Current (वर्तमान), Modern (आधुनिक)

4. Obstinate (जिद्दी): Docile (आज्ञाकारी), Flexible (लचीला)

5. Obtuse (मूर्ख): Astute (चतुर), Intelligent (बुद्धिमान)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Inquisitive".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Indifferent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Inquisitive" means eager to acquire knowledge; curious. (जिज्ञासु)

◦ Example: The inquisitive child kept asking her grandfather endless questions about how the old clock worked.

 

• "Indifferent" means having no particular interest or concern; apathetic, and is therefore the correct antonym. (उदासीन)

◦ Example: He remained indifferent to the heated debate happening around him, scrolling silently through his phone.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Curious (जिज्ञासु): eager to know or learn something — a synonym of inquisitive, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Inquiring (पूछताछ करने वाला): seeking information; questioning — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Nosy (दखल देने वाला): overly curious about others' affairs — close in sense to inquisitive.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of inquisitive: Curious, Inquiring, Nosy, Probing, Questioning.

• Synonyms of indifferent: Apathetic, Unconcerned, Uninterested, Detached.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Officious (दखल देने वाला): Timid (संकोची), Reserved (संयमी)

2. Often (अक्सर): Seldom (कभी-कभार), Rarely (बहुत कम)

3. Ominous (अशुभ): Auspicious (शुभ)

4. Oppose (विरोध करना): Encourage (प्रोत्साहित करना)

5. Opprobrium (निंदा): Honor (सम्मान), Praise (प्रशंसा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Fetish."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Indifference.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Fetish" means an excessive or irrational devotion to a particular thing. (अत्यधिक लगाव)

 

• "Indifference" means lack of interest, concern, or sympathy. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उदासीनता)

◦ Example: His indifference toward the promotion surprised colleagues who had expected him to campaign eagerly for the position.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Preoccupation (व्यस्तता) — the state of being engrossed in something; a synonym of fetish.

• Option 3: Obsession (जुनून) — an idea that continually preoccupies a person; a synonym of fetish.

• Option 4: Fixation (सनक) — an obsessive interest in something; a synonym of fetish.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of fetish: Detachment, Apathy, Disinterest.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Oppugn (विरोध करना): Defend (बचाव करना), Support (समर्थन करना)

2. Optimistic (आशावादी): Gloomy (उदास), Pessimistic (निराशावादी)

3. Oracular (दैवी संदेश देने वाला): Ordinary (साधारण), Uncertain (अनिश्चित)

4. Ostentatious (दिखावटी): Modest (विनम्र), Simple (सरल)

5. Ostracize (बहिष्कार करना): Patronize (सहारा देना), Accept (स्वीकार करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Conceit."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Modesty.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Conceit" means excessive pride in oneself; vanity. (अहंकार)

 

• "Modesty" means the quality of not being vain about one's abilities. It is therefore the correct antonym. (विनम्रता)

◦ Example: Despite winning the award, she accepted it with great modesty and thanked her entire team.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Vanity (घमंड) — excessive pride in appearance or achievements; a synonym of conceit.

• Option 2: Pride (गर्व) — sense of satisfaction from achievements; a synonym of conceit.

• Option 3: Arrogance (अहंकार) — offensive display of superiority; a synonym of conceit.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of conceit: Humility, Meekness, Simplicity.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Outgoing (मिलनसार): Introverted (अंतर्मुखी)

2. Overt (प्रत्यक्ष): Hidden (छिपा हुआ), Concealed (गुप्त)

3. Pacify (शांत करना): Aggravate (भड़काना)

4. Palliate (कम करना): Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Aggravate (और खराब करना)

5. Paralysed (अशक्त): Healthy (स्वस्थ), Active (सक्रिय)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Bulk."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Handful.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Bulk" means the mass or size of something large; the greater part. (बड़ा भाग)

 

• "Handful" means a small number or amount of something. It is therefore the correct antonym. (थोड़ा)

◦ Example: Only a handful of students showed up for the extra revision class held during the holidays.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Mass (भारी मात्रा) — a large body of matter with no definite shape; a synonym of bulk.

• Option 3: Volume (बड़ी मात्रा) — a large quantity or amount of something; a synonym of bulk.

• Option 4: Majority (बहुमत) — the greater part or number of something; a synonym of bulk.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of bulk: Minority, Fraction, Trace.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Parsimonious (कंजूस): Generous (उदार), Liberal (दानी)

2. Partial (पक्षपाती): Unbiased (निष्पक्ष), Fair (न्यायसंगत)

3. Patriot (देशभक्त): Traitor (देशद्रोही), Enemy (दुश्मन)

4. Peevish (चिड़चिड़ा): Pleasant (सुखद), Cheerful (प्रसन्न)

5. Penitence (पश्चाताप): Brazenness (निर्लज्जता), Shamelessness (निर्लज्जता)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Bloom".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Wither.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Bloom" means produce flowers; be in flower, or flourish. (खिलना)

◦ Example: The cherry trees in the garden bloom beautifully every spring, attracting visitors from all over the city.

 

• "Wither" means become dry and shriveled, especially through loss of moisture, and is therefore the correct antonym. (मुरझाना)

◦ Example: Without regular watering, the potted plants began to wither within just a few days of neglect.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Flourish (फलना-फूलना): grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way — a synonym of bloom, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Blossom (खिलना): produce flowers, or develop and flourish — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Flower (फूलना): produce flowers; bloom — close in sense to bloom.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of bloom: blossom, flourish, flower, thrive, burgeon.

• Synonyms of wither: shrivel, wilt, dry up, fade, decay.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Penniless (निर्धन): Rich (अमीर)

2. Pensive (चिंताग्रस्त): Ignorant (बेफिक्र/अज्ञान)

3. Penury (गरीबी): Wealth (धन), Richness (समृद्धि)

4. Perfidious (विश्वासघाती): Loyal (वफादार), Faithful (निष्ठावान)

5. Pernicious (हानिकारक): Innocuous (हानिरहित), Harmless (निर्दोष)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Bashful".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Loquacious.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Bashful" means shy or self-conscious, especially around other people. (संकोची / शर्मीला)

◦ Example: The bashful boy blushed and looked down whenever his classmates praised his artwork in front of everyone.

 

• "Loquacious" means tending to talk a great deal; very talkative, and is therefore the correct antonym. (बातूनी)

◦ Example: The loquacious guide kept the tourists entertained with endless stories throughout the entire three-hour walking tour.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Reserved (संकोची): slow to reveal emotion or opinions — a synonym of bashful, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Shy (शर्मीला): nervous or timid in the company of other people — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Timid (डरपोक): showing a lack of courage or confidence — close in sense to bashful.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of bashful: shy, timid, reserved, reticent, diffident.

• Synonyms of loquacious: talkative, chatty, voluble, garrulous, wordy.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Perseverance (दृढ़ता): Irresolution (अस्थिरता), Weakness (कमज़ोरी)

2. Persuade (मनाना): Dissuade (हतोत्साहित करना), Prevent (रोकना)

3. Perturbed (परेशान): Calm (शांत), Composed (संयमित)

4. Piquant (चटपटा): Bland (फीका), Tasteless (बेस्वाद)

5. Pleasure (खुशी): Pain (दर्द), Sorrow (दुख)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Monotonous".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Engrossing.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Monotonous" means dull and repetitive; lacking variety or interest. (नीरस)

◦ Example: The monotonous hum of the factory machines made the night shift feel endless for the workers.

 

• "Engrossing" means absorbing all one's attention; fascinating, and is therefore the correct antonym. (रोचक)

◦ Example: The novel proved so engrossing that she finished all six hundred pages in a single sitting.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Tedious (थकाऊ): too long, slow, or dull — a synonym of monotonous, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Repetitive (दोहरावदार): done or happening repeatedly — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Dull (उबाऊ): lacking interest or excitement — close in sense to monotonous.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of monotonous: Tedious, Repetitive, Dull, Boring, Humdrum.

• Synonyms of engrossing: Fascinating, Absorbing, Riveting, Captivating.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Plight (दुर्दशा): Advantage (लाभ), Comfort (सुख)

2. Polite (विनम्र): Rude (असभ्य)

3. Pompous (घमंडी): Modest (विनम्र), Humble (नम्र)

4. Ponderous (भारी): Light (हल्का), Agile (फुर्तीला)

5. Porous (छिद्रयुक्त): Impermeable (अभेद्य), Solid (ठोस)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Surreptitious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Overt.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Surreptitious" means kept secret, especially because it would not be approved of. (गुप्त)

 

• "Overt" means done or shown openly; not hidden or secret. It is therefore the correct antonym. (खुला)

◦ Example: The company launched an overt campaign to promote its new product across major cities.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Clandestine (छिपा हुआ) — done secretly, often illicitly; a synonym of surreptitious.

• Option 2: Covert (गुप्त/छिपा हुआ) — not openly acknowledged or shown; a synonym of surreptitious.

• Option 3: Secretive (गुप्त) — inclined to hide one's actions; a synonym of surreptitious.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of surreptitious: Open, Obvious, Public.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Praised (प्रशंसा की): Rebuked (डांटा), Criticized (आलोचना की)

2. Precise (सटीक): Rough (अस्पष्ट/अनगढ़)

3. Predicament (कठिन परिस्थिति): Solution (समाधान), Relief (राहत)

4. Predictable (पूर्वानुमेय): Unpredictable (अप्रत्याशित), Unexpected (अचानक)

5. Probably (संभवतः): Definitely (निश्चित रूप से), Certainly (निश्चित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Lengthy."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Concise.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Lengthy" means very long, especially in duration or extent. (लंबा / विस्तृत)

 

• "Concise" means giving information clearly in a few words; brief. It is therefore the correct antonym. (संक्षिप्त)

◦ Example: The editor asked the reporter to submit a concise summary of the event instead of a detailed account.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Prolonged (दीर्घकालिक) — continuing for a long time; a synonym of lengthy.

• Option 2: Extended (विस्तारित) — made longer in time or extent; a synonym of lengthy.

• Option 3: Long (लंबा) — having great length or duration; a synonym of lengthy.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of lengthy: Brief, Succinct, Short.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Profuse (प्रचुर): Scarce (कमी), Sparse (अल्प)

2. Prohibition (प्रतिबंध): Permission (अनुमति), Allowance (इजाजत)

3. Prominent (प्रमुख): Obscure (अप्रसिद्ध), Hidden (छिपा हुआ)

4. Propitiate (मनाना / शांत करना): Enrage (क्रोधित करना), Agitate (उत्तेजित करना)

5. Prosaic (साधारण): Imaginative (कल्पनाशील), Creative (रचनात्मक)
